exit_criteria.description: Every in-scope historical observation has actual file/hash/locator and a justified supported/unsupported/contradicted/not_assessed disposition; no large-matrix attestation invented.
All L01-L08 have exact version/retrieval/full-text-access disposition; snapshots or explicit unavailable reasons and full-text locators match the stated review level.
Theory and tree-axis comparisons preserve assumptions/limits; no abstract-only promotion and no forced reconciliation or universal mechanistic claim.

R2 proposal specifies teacher/normalization/seeds/axes/noise/solver/metrics/uncertainty/exposure/falsifiers and readiness without running models; Cursor subagent reviews it for subsequent autonomous planning.
Coverage, acquisition, resource and pre-freeze exposure records validate; outputs contain no fabricated measurements/approvals and infrastructure tests pass.
All tasks and reviewer notes distinguish author and review subagent; missing/negative items and limitations are retained, enabling honest operational closure.

predictions.statement: Existing small historical artifacts do not establish double descent on the old corpus; contradicting coherent artifacts must be recorded instead of suppressed.
Detailed axis/loss/assumption comparison is necessary before transferring tree/GBDT results; unresolved comparability remains explicit.
A bounded R2 design can distinguish noise, spectrum and regularization using controlled linear/random-feature models, or document why it is not yet identifiable.

review_policy: Distinct Cursor reviewer subagent; local team review, no human/Codex sign-off required. Semantic locator and scientific reasoning checks cannot be replaced by structural validation.
output_policy: Capture real agent-authored source notes plus immutable intake snapshots as declared inputs. Scripts validate/export; they do not impersonate an automated scientific reader. Seal pre-freeze preparation log; subsequent runtime events go in attempt logs/report.
completion_policy: Complete coverage with justified dispositions, not mandatory positive claims, successful downloads or peaks. Continue autonomous R2 preparation if no critical escalation.
